title: Project bounded command results without changing meaning
description: Present bounded selected task outcomes and actual effects without inventing authority or hiding commitment.
inputs: Admitted operation/result domain, actual semantic/storage outcome, and selected values with scope and identities.
Requested format/detail, applicable byte budget, and observations with revision and exact observed-subject basis.
outputs: Complete bounded family-specific outcome with actual effects, established identities and safe diagnostic distinctions.
Selected scope, explicit gaps or omissions and the actual committed, unchanged, failed or uncertain standing.
behavior: Saved, unchanged, preview, rejected, conflict, busy, and recovery-needed outcomes retain their exact operation/version/exit meanings and available identities. A recording receipt claims persistence only; errors and observations remain distinct and never echo arbitrary payloads or secrets.

Text and JSON preserve equivalent selected fields, state, omissions, optional absence, and decoded narrative, including paragraphs, code, Unicode, literal backslash sequences, and ordered arrays. Budget failure occurs before output rather than emitting truncated content.

Every admissible mutation has a prepublication mandatory receipt that fits independently of diagnostic volume. Excess optional details are explicitly omitted; increasing diagnostics cannot reject a sound correction or turn completed publication into rejected output.

Current context identifies the selected scope, available selectors and explicit omissions. Compared observations remain scope-limited and separate from attributed judgments; no cursor or observation-detail continuation protocol is required.
Selected Review and Verification accounts derive from stored values without inventing rationale, conflating absent support with approval or treating complete retrieval as engineering adequacy.
Each supported public family preserves actual effects, safe-continuation facts and its declared exit meaning across admitted output formats.

Backup, restoration, transfer and migration receipts identify their selected project, captured or restored scope, state identity, exclusions and actual completeness. Storage completion does not establish current evidence applicability or engineering approval.

failure_behavior.condition: A selected read or mandatory receipt cannot fit its defined bound.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop before partial output or commitment with an explicit limit result.

failure_behavior.condition: Output delivery fails after actual commitment.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve the known committed or uncertain standing; require current inspection before a fresh actor decision, never semantic replay.
